title: GENAI DETECTION TOOLS, ADVERSARIAL TECHNIQUES AND IMPLICATIONS FOR INCLUSIVITY IN HIGHER EDUCATION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating AI text detection tools using human-written control samples from non-native English speakers (NNES) and AI-generated texts manipulated via adversarial prompts to mimic the writing style of a non-native English speaker (IELTS Band Level 6) to measure false accusation rates and detection evasion effectiveness.
